description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of four methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across two metrics: Accuracy (%) on the left y-axis (ranging from 70 to 100 in increments of 5) and Token Count on the right y-axis (ranging from 0 to 800 in increments of 100), with each method represented by a distinct color-coded bar pair. The horizontal axis lists the methods in order: CoT (maroon), CoD (brown), CCoT (gray-blue), and CoUT (green). For Accuracy (%), CoT achieves the highest value at 91.19%, followed by CCoT at 88.50%, CoUT at 88.40%, and CoD at 80.89%. For Token Count, CoT again leads with 676.85 tokens, followed by CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and CoUT at 354.46. The chart visually emphasizes that CoT yields the highest accuracy but also the highest token usage, while CoUT offers the lowest token count with accuracy close to CCoT and significantly better than CoD. The bars are grouped by method, with each pair aligned vertically to allow direct comparison of the two metrics per method, and all values are explicitly labeled above their respective bars.
